page_or_section: page 22 'City pairs - Contract, Headhaul Contract Rates, Data on Rates'; page 25 'City pairs - Spot, Headhaul Spot Rates, Data on Rates'; methodology page 36
role: source values for the beta_i candidate derivation
access_date_basis: read on this date from the local pdf copy identified in local_copy. the euro sign was confirmed on rendered images of pages 22 and 25, because the pdf text layer does not map that glyph

vat_status.note: the 38 pages were searched for VAT wording; none applies to the rates

effective_date.value: Q2 2026, quarterly average of weekly median rates
effective_date.source_wording: Ti then used the median rates provided by Upply on each corridor, averaging weekly rates over each quarter.

unit_basis.value: EUR per km on an international headhaul lane, printed beside an index with Q1-2017 = 100; not per tonne and not per tonne-km

service_category.value: international road freight line-haul, truck load (LTL and FTL)
service_category.source_wording: Upply provides Truck Load (LTL & FTL) weekly rates estimations based on observed transactions for each major European trade lanes, associated with a confidence index.

fuel_surcharge_treatment.note: the report attributes rate increases to diesel costs being passed on ('Fuel has been the dominant driver in pushing rates upwards QoQ and YoY, with operators unable to absorb the scale of diesel increases without passing them through to customers', page 4) but never states whether the per-km rates include or exclude a separate fuel surcharge

payload_or_load_factor.note: no payload, load factor or tonnage behind the per-km rates is stated in the 38 pages; the document was searched for payload, tonne, capacity and load factor

observations.printed_as: The Warsaw to Duisburg route closed Q2 2026 at 166.8 index points, or €1.45/km, up 6.1 points QoQ and 14.9 points compared with the same quarter last year.
Contract rates on the Duisburg to Lille lane reached 159.4 index points (€2.58/km) in Q2 2026, up 13.1 points QoQ and 22.2 points YoY.
Duisburg to Prague contract rates reached 149.2 index points in Q2 2026, equivalent to €1.73/km. The index rose by 11.6 points QoQ and by 19.7 points YoY.
Antwerp to Duisburg closed Q2 2026 at 181.8 index points, or €3.05/km, up 17.1 points QoQ and 25.1 points compared with the same quarter last year.
The Warsaw to Duisburg route closed Q2 2026 at 170.4 index points, or €1.51/km, up 10.9 points QoQ and 17.3 points compared with the same quarter last year.
Spot rates on the Duisburg to Lille lane reached 168.2 index points (€2.89/km) in Q2 2026, up 20.0 points QoQ and 23.2 points YoY.
Duisburg to Prague spot rates reached 156.4 index points in Q2 2026, equivalent to €2.00/km. The index rose by 13.8 points QoQ and by 19.5 points YoY.
Antwerp to Duisburg spot rates stood at 167.6 index points (€3.19/km), up 13.9 points QoQ and 17.9 points YoY.

verification_note: corridor rates and page references only, as printed on pages 22 and 25; no payload division, derivation arithmetic or comparison to 0.07163 is recorded here, that lives in data/processed/v5/logistics/beta_candidate_derivation.json
